pedidos.instruccion_en: Remove any blur or softness from every 'amua' word (the logo at the top and the one on the bottle label): render them fully sharp, crisp and readable, same font, size, color and position. Change nothing else: keep the women, poses, background, bottle, labels, arrow, all other texts and the bottom block exactly as they are.
pedidos.resumen: La marca «amua» queda nítida, sin difuminado, arriba y en la etiqueta del frasco. Lo demás no cambia.
